name: Jace
source:
Mysterious twin of Blace who appeared as a transfer student. He is in the same class as the heroine. His whole body is bandaged for unknown reason. Jace seems easier to approach than his brother. He does not like to reveal anything from his background.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/blace-and-jace.html]official website[/url]]
